views.name: qualifying_game_records
views.body_sql:
SELECT B.BowlerID AS bowler_id,
       B.BowlerFirstName AS bowler_first_name,
       B.BowlerLastName AS bowler_last_name,
       BS.MatchID AS match_number,
       BS.GameNumber AS game_number,
       BS.HandiCapScore AS handicap_score,
       T.TourneyDate AS tournament_date,
       T.TourneyLocation AS location
FROM Bowler_Scores BS
JOIN Bowlers B ON BS.BowlerID = B.BowlerID
JOIN Tourney_Matches TM ON BS.MatchID = TM.MatchID
JOIN Tournaments T ON TM.TourneyID = T.TourneyID
views.description: game records where the bowler won and the handicap score is within the target threshold, restricted to the specified venues

views.name: final_game_records
views.body_sql: SELECT bowler_id, bowler_first_name, bowler_last_name, match_number, game_number, handicap_score, tournament_date, location FROM qualifying_game_records
views.description: joins qualifying game records with bowlers who have achieved at least one qualifying win at each of the three venues
